description: Solvent accessibility and pLDDT at the ubiquitin Ile44-patch positions mapped onto worm BAG-1 and human BAG1 ULDs
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"})
def get(u):
    r=S.get(u,timeout=120); r.raise_for_status(); return r.text
P={"worm":get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-O44739-F1-model_v6.pdb"),
   "human":get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q99933-F1-model_v6.pdb"),
   "ubq":get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1UBQ.pdb")}
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
VDW={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80}
def parse(txt,lo,hi):
    res={}
    for l in txt.split("\n"):
        if not l.startswith("ATOM") or l[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
        rn=l[17:20].strip()
        if rn not in AA3: continue
        ri=int(l[22:26])
        if not (lo<=ri<=hi): continue
        an=l[12:16].strip(); el=(l[76:78].strip() or an[0])
        d=res.setdefault(ri,{"aa":AA3[rn],"at":[],"b":float(l[60:66])})
        d["at"].append((an,el,np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])))
        if an=="CA": d["b"]=float(l[60:66])
    return dict(sorted(res.items()))
def sphere(n=200):
    i=np.arange(n)+0.5; phi=np.arccos(1-2*i/n); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*i
    return np.c_[np.cos(th)*np.sin(phi),np.sin(th)*np.sin(phi),np.cos(phi)]
SP=sphere(240)
def sasa(res, probe=1.4):
    atoms=[]; owner=[]
    for ri,d in res.items():
        for an,el,x in d["at"]:
            atoms.append((x,VDW.get(el,1.7))); owner.append(ri)
    X=np.array([a[0] for a in atoms]); R=np.array([a[1] for a in atoms])+probe
    out={ri:0.0 for ri in res}
    D=np.linalg.norm(X[:,None]-X[None,:],axis=2)
    for i in range(len(X)):
        nb=np.where((D[i]<R[i]+R.max())&(np.arange(len(X))!=i))[0]
        pts=X[i]+R[i]*SP
        acc=np.ones(len(SP),bool)
        for j in nb:
            acc &= (np.linalg.norm(pts-X[j],axis=1)>=R[j])
        out[owner[i]] += 4*np.pi*R[i]**2*acc.mean()
    return out
# Tien et al. 2013 theoretical max ASA
MAXASA={'A':129,'R':274,'N':195,'D':193,'C':167,'Q':225,'E':223,'G':104,'H':224,'I':197,'L':201,
        'K':236,'M':224,'F':240,'P':159,'S':155,'T':172,'W':285,'Y':263,'V':174}

ubq=parse(P["ubq"],1,76); worm=parse(P["worm"],1,91); hum=parse(P["human"],144,230)
SA={"ubq":sasa(ubq),"worm":sasa(worm),"human":sasa(hum)}

MAP=[  # (ubq_pos, worm_pos, human_pos, role)
 (8 , 8 ,151,'L8  core patch'),
 (42,49 ,189,'R42 patch rim'),
 (44,51 ,191,'I44 patch centre'),
 (45,52 ,192,'F45 patch'),
 (49,56 ,196,'Q49 patch edge'),
 (68,77 ,216,'H68 patch rim'),
 (70,79 ,218,'V70 patch'),
 (71,80 ,219,'L71 patch edge'),
 (72,81 ,220,'R72 patch rim'),
 (73,84 ,222,'L73 C-tail'),
 (75,87 ,227,'G75 processing'),
 (76,91 ,230,'G76 diGly'),
]
rows=[]
for up,wp,hp,role in MAP:
    r={}
    for tag,st,pos in [("ubiquitin",ubq,up),("worm_BAG-1",worm,wp),("human_BAG1",hum,hp)]:
        aa=st[pos]["aa"]; s=SA[{"ubiquitin":"ubq","worm_BAG-1":"worm","human_BAG1":"human"}[tag]][pos]
        r[tag]=f"{aa}{pos}"; r[tag+"_RSA%"]=round(100*s/MAXASA[aa],1)
    r["role"]=role
    r["worm_pLDDT"]=round(worm[wp]["b"],1); r["human_pLDDT"]=round(hum[hp]["b"],1)
    rows.append(r)
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)[["role","ubiquitin","ubiquitin_RSA%","worm_BAG-1","worm_BAG-1_RSA%","worm_pLDDT",
                       "human_BAG1","human_BAG1_RSA%","human_pLDDT"]]
print(df.to_string(index=False))

# hydrophobicity of the 5-residue patch core (ubq L8,I44,V70 + rim R42,R72)
KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,'L':3.8,
    'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
core=[(8,8,151),(44,51,191),(70,79,218)]
for tag,st,idx in [("ubiquitin",ubq,0),("worm BAG-1",worm,1),("human BAG1",hum,2)]:
    aas=[st[t[idx]]["aa"] for t in core]
    sasv=[SA[{"ubiquitin":"ubq","worm BAG-1":"worm","human BAG1":"human"}[tag]][t[idx]] for t in core]
    print(f"{tag:11s} core L8/I44/V70-equivalents = {''.join(aas)}  meanKD={np.mean([KD[a] for a in aas]):+.2f}  summedSASA={sum(sasv):.0f} A^2")

# mean pLDDT across domains
print("\nmean pLDDT worm ULD 8-85 :", round(np.mean([worm[i]['b'] for i in worm if 8<=i<=85]),1))
print("mean pLDDT human ULD 144-224:", round(np.mean([hum[i]['b'] for i in hum if 144<=i<=224]),1))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5))
ax=axes[0]
lbl=[r.split()[0] for r in df["role"]]
x=np.arange(len(lbl)); w=0.27
ax.bar(x-w,df["ubiquitin_RSA%"],w,label="ubiquitin (1UBQ)",color="#4C78A8")
ax.bar(x  ,df["worm_BAG-1_RSA%"],w,label="C. elegans BAG-1 (AF)",color="#F58518")
ax.bar(x+w,df["human_BAG1_RSA%"],w,label="human BAG1 (AF)",color="#54A24B")
for i,(a,b,c) in enumerate(zip(df["ubiquitin"],df["worm_BAG-1"],df["human_BAG1"])):
    ax.text(i-w,df['ubiquitin_RSA%'][i]+1,a,ha="center",fontsize=7,rotation=90)
    ax.text(i  ,df['worm_BAG-1_RSA%'][i]+1,b,ha="center",fontsize=7,rotation=90)
    ax.text(i+w,df['human_BAG1_RSA%'][i]+1,c,ha="center",fontsize=7,rotation=90)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(lbl,rotation=45,ha="right")
ax.set_ylabel("relative solvent accessibility (%)"); ax.set_ylim(0,100)
ax.set_title("Proteasome-recognition surface of ubiquitin\nmapped by structural superposition onto BAG-1 ULDs")
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax2=axes[1]
ax2.plot([worm[i]['b'] for i in sorted(worm)],color="#F58518",label="C. elegans BAG-1 1-91")
ax2.plot(np.arange(len(hum)),[hum[i]['b'] for i in sorted(hum)],color="#54A24B",label="human BAG1 144-230")
ax2.axhline(70,ls="--",c="grey"); ax2.axhline(90,ls=":",c="grey")
ax2.set_xlabel("position within modelled ULD window"); ax2.set_ylabel("pLDDT")
ax2.set_title("AlphaFold confidence across the ubiquitin-like domain")
ax2.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
df.to_csv("/tmp/rsa_table.csv",index=False)
